steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Access main control
steps.body: Remove console. Verify all connectors fully seated at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove console. Verify all connectors fully seated at ACU.

steps.title: Restore power for line check
steps.body: Plug in or reconnect power for live measurements only.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Plug in or reconnect power for live measurements only.

steps.title: Line voltage J1-1 to J1-2
steps.body: AC voltmeter: black probe J1-1 (Neutral), red probe J1-2 (Line). Expect 120 VAC.

branches.label: No line voltage
branches.oemOutcome: Check outlet, breaker, and AC power cord continuity.

steps.sourceExcerpt: AC voltmeter: black probe J1-1 (Neutral), red probe J1-2 (Line). Expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: Diagnostic LED state
steps.body: Is the Diagnostic LED flashing, continuously ON, or OFF?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Is the Diagnostic LED flashing, continuously ON, or OFF?

steps.title: Isolate HMI load on J5
steps.body: Disconnect power. Remove connector J5 from main control. Restore power.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Remove connector J5 from main control. Restore power.

steps.title: +12 VDC at J5
steps.body: DC volts: black J5-4 (Circuit Gnd), red J5-1 (+12 VDC). Do not short pins.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: black J5-4 (Circuit Gnd), red J5-1 (+12 VDC). Do not short pins.

branches.label: No line voltage
branches.oemOutcome: Check outlet, breaker, and AC power cord continuity.

source.manualTitle: Maytag 4.8 cu ft Top Load Washer (MVW6200, W11416395B)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Service Test valve pre-check
steps.body: In Service Test Mode, run automatic water valve sequence. Note any valve that fails to energize.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Service Test Mode, run automatic water valve sequence. Note any valve that fails to energize.

steps.title: Disconnect J8 at ACU
steps.body: Unplug washer. Remove console. Disconnect J8 from main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug washer. Remove console. Disconnect J8 from main control.

steps.title: Valve coil resistance at J8
steps.body: Measure each coil J8-1 (common) to valve pin: Cold J8-3, Hot J8-5, Fabric Softener J8-6. Expect 890–1090 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure each coil J8-1 (common) to valve pin: Cold J8-3, Hot J8-5, Fabric Softener J8-6. Expect 890–1090 Ω.

steps.title: Reconnect J8 and restore power
steps.body: Reconnect J8. Reassemble panels. Restore power for Service Test valve sequence.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J8. Reassemble panels. Restore power for Service Test valve sequence.

steps.title: Continue to Service Test Mode
steps.body: You should now be in Service Diagnostic mode. Press Key 2 then START to enter Service Test Mode for load/function commands.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Diagnostic mode must be active before Service Test Mode (Key 2 + START).

steps.title: Valves energize in Service Test Mode
steps.body: Does each valve in question turn on during Service Test water valve sequence?

branches.label: Ohms OK but valve does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Coils in range but no run — replace main control.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Does each valve in question turn on during Service Test water valve sequence?

branches.label: Ohms OK but valve does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Coils in range but no run — replace main control.

source.manualTitle: Maytag 4.8 cu ft Top Load Washer (MVW6200, W11416395B)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic and clear codes
steps.body: Activate Service Diagnostic. Retrieve and clear F7E1, F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7 if present.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate Service Diagnostic. Retrieve and clear F7E1, F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7 if present.

steps.title: Slow wash/agitate in Component Activation
steps.body: In Component Activation, run Slow Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Component Activation, run Slow Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?

steps.title: Spin Low Speed test
steps.body: Run Spin Low Speed in Component Activation. If motor hums briefly then stops, check fault codes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run Spin Low Speed in Component Activation. If motor hums briefly then stops, check fault codes.

steps.title: Continue to shifter or motor test
steps.body: Shifter-related (F7E3/F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6/F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Shifter-related (F7E3/F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6/F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.

source.manualTitle: Maytag 4.8 cu ft Top Load Washer (MVW6200, W11416395B)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Spin and Wash in Component Activation
steps.body: Lid closed and locked. Run Spin and Wash tests. Did shifter engage for both?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Lid closed and locked. Run Spin and Wash tests. Did shifter engage for both?

steps.title: Motor and shifter turn independently
steps.body: Power off. Motor and shifter should turn independently. If locked together, shifter slider issue.

branches.label: Locked together or bound
branches.oemOutcome: Replace shifter assembly — slider binds or motor/shifter locked.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Motor and shifter should turn independently. If locked together, shifter slider issue.

steps.title: J2 and J6 fully seated
steps.body: Verify J2 and J6 inserted fully at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify J2 and J6 inserted fully at ACU.

steps.title: Reseat J2/J6 and retest
steps.body: Reconnect connectors and repeat Component Activation Spin/Wash.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect connectors and repeat Component Activation Spin/Wash.

steps.title: Shifter coil resistance J6-2 to J6-6
steps.body: Remove J6. Expect 2–3.5 kΩ (2000–3500 Ω) across shifter coil.

testPoint.label: Shifter coil resistance J6-2 to J6-6

measurements.title: Shifter coil resistance J6-2 to J6-6

steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove J6. Expect 2–3.5 kΩ (2000–3500 Ω) across shifter coil.

steps.title: 120 VAC at shifter when commanded
steps.body: Restore power. AC volts J6-2 to J6-6. Toggle shifter ON/OFF in Component Activation (motor stopped). Expect 120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. AC volts J6-2 to J6-6. Toggle shifter ON/OFF in Component Activation (motor stopped). Expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: Shifter status voltage J2-1
steps.body: DC volts: black J2-2 (Gnd), red J2-1. Toggle Spin/Agitate — SPIN = +5 VDC, AGITATE = 0 VDC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: black J2-2 (Gnd), red J2-1. Toggle Spin/Agitate — SPIN = +5 VDC, AGITATE = 0 VDC.

steps.title: +12 VDC tach power J2-3
steps.body: DC volts: black J2-2, red J2-3. Expect +12 VDC. Then verify tach in Sensor Feedback.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: black J2-2, red J2-3. Expect +12 VDC. Then verify tach in Sensor Feedback.

steps.title: Shifter harness continuity
steps.body: Power off. Tilt washer. Continuity shifter pins to J2/J6 per OEM chart?

branches.label: Open harness
branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower washer harness.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Tilt washer. Continuity shifter pins to J2/J6 per OEM chart?

branches.oemOutcome: Replace shifter assembly — slider binds or motor/shifter locked.

branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower washer harness.

steps.title: Motor Slow Wash in Component Activation
steps.body: Run Motor Slow Wash test. Does basket spin clockwise during Low/Mid/High spin tests?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run Motor Slow Wash test. Does basket spin clockwise during Low/Mid/High spin tests?

steps.title: Basket turns freely
steps.body: Power off. Basket should turn freely.

branches.label: Does not turn freely
branches.oemOutcome: Resolve mechanical friction or lockup before motor replacement.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Basket should turn freely.

steps.title: J2 and J6 fully seated
steps.body: Verify J2 and J6 fully inserted at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify J2 and J6 fully inserted at ACU.

steps.title: Reseat connectors and retest
steps.body: Reconnect J2/J6 and repeat Component Activation wash/spin.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J2/J6 and repeat Component Activation wash/spin.

steps.title: Motor winding resistance at J6
steps.body: Remove J6. CW J6-4↔6 and CCW J6-1↔6. Each expect 5–9.5 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove J6. CW J6-4↔6 and CCW J6-1↔6. Each expect 5–9.5 Ω.

steps.title: Motor harness continuity
steps.body: Tilt washer. Continuity motor connector to J6 and run capacitor per OEM chart?

branches.label: Open harness
branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower machine harness.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Tilt washer. Continuity motor connector to J6 and run capacitor per OEM chart?

steps.title: Motor resistance at drive connector
steps.body: At motor: CW pins 3↔2 and CCW pins 4↔2. Expect 5–9.5 Ω each.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At motor: CW pins 3↔2 and CCW pins 4↔2. Expect 5–9.5 Ω each.

steps.title: Run capacitor charge/discharge test
steps.body: Discharge capacitor with 20 kΩ resistor. Measure terminals — steady increase in resistance = good; short/open = replace capacitor.

branches.label: Capacitor shorted or open
branches.oemOutcome: Replace run capacitor, calibrate, and retest.

steps.title: Button Activation & Encoder Test

steps.sourceExcerpt: In Service Diagnostic, press Key 1 for Button Activation & Encoder test. Do keys toggle LED groups and encoder rotate status LEDs?

steps.title: J5 and HMI harness seated
steps.body: Power off. J5 fully seated at ACU; HMI harness and ribbon cables fully connected.

steps.title: HMI harness continuity J5 to HMI J1
steps.body: Continuity J5-1↔HMI J1-1 (Red), J5-3↔J1-2 (Yellow), J5-4↔J1-3 (Black)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity J5-1↔HMI J1-1 (Red), J5-3↔J1-2 (Yellow), J5-4↔J1-3 (Black)?

steps.title: Verify ACU supply

steps.sourceExcerpt: If harness good, run TEST #1 Main Control supply checks.

steps.title: Retest HMI in Service mode
steps.body: Reassemble, restore power, enter Service Diagnostic, rerun Button Activation test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reassemble, restore power, enter Service Diagnostic, rerun Button Activation test.

steps.sourceExcerpt: In Service Sensor Feedback, run Water Level Pressure Sensor cycle. Valves open, level rises on display, then decreases as basket drains.

steps.title: Pressure hose and dome

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Hose secure at ACU transducer and tub dome? Routed without pinch? Clear of water/suds/debris?

steps.body: Disconnect hose at ACU, blow clear, fix routing, replace if leaking. Retest Sensor Feedback.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect hose at ACU, blow clear, fix routing, replace if leaking. Retest Sensor Feedback.

steps.body: Remove J4. Lock solenoid expect 50–160 Ω. Lock switch J4-1↔2: locked=0 Ω, unlocked=open. Lid switch J4-2↔1: open=open, closed=open circuit per table.
